tag.name: Tag
tag.purpose: Represent compact metadata labels for type, platform, category, support level, and semantic status.

anatomy.rule: Owns compact shape, surface, border, density, and optional focus.
Adds semantic status without replacing text.

variants.description: Metadata that navigates or filters when behavior is explicit.

Energy.decision: Use Energy for subtle metadata surfaces and semantic tones.
Energy.behavior: Tag tone supports scan value without replacing the label.

Voice.decision: Use Voice for short metadata labels.

Frame.decision: Use Frame for compact shape, border, spacing, and wrapping.
Frame.behavior: Tag keeps intrinsic width and wraps in groups.

Depth.decision: Use Depth through parent surfaces only.
Depth.example: Tag sits on Card or catalog row.

Momentum.decision: Use Momentum only for interactive tag hover or press.
Momentum.behavior: Static tags do not animate as controls.
Momentum.rejectIf: Static metadata animates like a button.

State.decision: Use State for default, hover, pressed, focus, and disabled when interactive.
State.behavior: State exists only when behavior exists.
State.test: Verify static tags are not focusable.
State.rejectIf: Tag exposes selected or removable state.

Tone.decision: Use Tone for metadata meaning and support language.

Growth.decision: Use Growth so metadata labels can scale across catalogs, cards, and templates.
Growth.rejectIf: Each metadata group forks a local tag.

Symbol.decision: Use Symbol for optional icons that clarify the label.

Iconography.decision: Use Iconography for compact icon size and alignment.

Accessibility.decision: Use Accessibility for static text, link, or button semantics based on behavior.
Accessibility.behavior: Static tags are not focusable; interactive tags have a real action.

do: Keep tags static unless behavior exists.
dont: Do not use for selected or removable filters.
Do not use as Tabs or Buttons.
info: Interactive metadata may escalate into catalog filters or navigation patterns.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: one or two high-value tags near title

agentInstructions: Use Tag for metadata labels only.
Ask before making a tag interactive.
Use Badge for counts, Chip for selected/removable filters, Tabs for sibling views, and Button for actions.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Metadata purpose: metadata, status, platform, or link.

props.name: state
props.notes: Local display state for interactive tags: default, hover, pressed, focus, or disabled.

props.name: interactive
props.notes: Renders the tag as an interactive button.

rejectIf: Interactive tag without destination or action
